title: The year on one rail
label: A product roadmap on a time axis from Q1 to Q4 2027 with three tracks: Product, Platform and Customers. Each track holds dated milestones, some single days and some ranges drawn as bars. A Today marker walks the axis: milestones behind it fill in, bars fill as it passes through them, and planned ones stay outlined. When it reaches the workflow builder launch in June, its flag opens into a card with the date and what ships.
heading:
Four quarters,
three tracks, one plan.
sub: Shipped work fills in as the year moves. Dates are targets we review every month.
